Medical image

Computational
pathology

03 / Language

Clinical NLP &
reporting workflows

Clinical notes · Information extraction · AI-assisted reporting

Investigate failure modes, domain shift and confidence. Evaluate models across sites and datasets, and make trade-offs visible before the next investment.

External validation · Uncertainty quantification · Robustness

Connect preprocessing, training and evaluation. Develop privacy-preserving workflows, containerized services and CI/CD for reproducible delivery.

03 / Define what matters

Give patterns
a useful label.

Classification assigns categories to an image or a region. The important work is defining those categories, checking the labels and testing on data the model has never seen.

Show illustrative colour groups

These broad regions illustrate grouping by appearance. They do not identify cell types, biomarkers or disease.

How we work

A clear scope.
A working handover.

Work directly with a specialist. Start with the question, agree what success means and keep progress visible throughout the engagement.

01↗

Understand & scope

Review the use case, available data and technical constraints. Agree the deliverables, evaluation criteria and data-handling requirements.

Outcome / A practical project plan
02↗

Develop & evaluate

Build in reviewable stages, test against the agreed criteria and document the results. Surface limitations and trade-offs as the work progresses.

Outcome / Working code and evidence
03↗

Deliver & hand over

Provide the code, documentation and operating guidance your team needs. Agree any further integration, monitoring or technical support.

Outcome / A result your team can use
Neel Kanwal, Ph.D.Founder · Oslo, Norway
Research-led. Personally involved.

Scientific depth.
Hands-on delivery.

Nevyon DataLabs was founded by Neel Kanwal, a researcher and machine learning engineer with a Ph.D. from the University of Stavanger.

His research spans computational pathology, artifact detection and uncertainty estimation, clinical note summarization, time-series modelling and privacy-preserving image processing. That range informs how he approaches data quality, evaluation and practical engineering.

You work directly with the person building and evaluating your solution.
